endorsements.name: Andres Moreno
endorsements.label: RHME2 challenges and solutions
endorsements.description: An embedded CTF called rhme2 (Riscure Hack Me 2) started in November 2016, running until February 28 2017. Riscure prepared a small arduino board with a custom bootloader and shipped it to 500 participants, allowing them to load 22 challenges in the following categories: Side Channel Analysis, Fault Injection, Reverse Engineering, Cryptography, Software Exploitation and Other. In this talk we will take a look at the results of the game, highlight the most interesting challenges and the most surprising solutions we received from the challenge participants.
